_field_guide.asset_type: audio | mesh | image | decal | video. A video's soundtrack is also recorded with the audio fields, by role, under the same owner-listen rule.
_field_guide.clip_id: The asset's local key (kept as clip_id for compatibility with the audio receipts; use it for meshes, images and video too).
_field_guide.intended_use: audio: bed | music | sfx | ui | speech. mesh: prop | architecture | hero. image: texture | decal | ui | concept. video: screen | cutscene.
_field_guide.source.input_files: Concept images or reference files fed to the model, each as {path, sha256}.
_field_guide.source.third_party_inputs: Samples, impulse responses, fonts, HDRIs, photos, presets, copied code: each as {name, licence, link}.
_field_guide.source.suno_permitted_download: true only if obtained through Suno's approved download channel while on Pro or Premier; false for trial downloads, remixes, or rips
_field_guide.account.account_name: Provider and account name only, in the private receipt. Use only the project's designated generation account. Never store keys.
_field_guide.licence_basis.fal_badge: Commercial use | Research only | none (copy from the model page on the day)
_field_guide.spend_approval: Recorded owner spend approval (who, cap, scope, date) for any paid call or Robux fee. Not needed for local code-generated assets: set required to false.
_field_guide.files: Every file that will be imported or uploaded (GLB/FBX, each texture map, WAV/OGG, MP4), with SHA-256. The owner's yes covers these hashes only.
_field_guide.measured (audio): lufs_integrated, true_peak_dbtp, clipping, loop_wrap (pass | fail | n/a), max_momentary_lufs, attack_10_90_ms, vs_bed_db, bed_clip_id, guardrail (pass | fail | n/a; fail if a cue with 10-90% rise < 10 ms sits more than 6 dB above the bed at the standing spot).
_field_guide.measured (mesh): triangles per mesh (<= 20,000), texture_maps as {map, px}, normal_space (OpenGL), render_fidelity, collision_fidelity, visual_gate (pass | fail with H/M/L counts).
_field_guide.measured (image): image_px, alpha (none | straight | cut-out | tint-mask), contrast_ratio for UI text or icons.
_field_guide.measured.moderation_precheck: pass, or the issue found (text, logo, face, gore, etc.) from the moderation list.
_field_guide.roblox.upload_path: Asset Manager | Creator Dashboard | 3D Importer | Open Cloud
_field_guide.owner_listen_approval: The owner's review of the asset itself: a listen for audio and video, a look for meshes and images. status: pending | approved | rejected | not_required_code_generated (code-generated audio only).
_field_guide.owner_listen_approval.quote: The owner's own words. An agent's say-so is never approval.
_field_guide.owner_upload_yes: Always required, for every asset type including code-generated audio: the owner's explicit yes to import or upload these exact files under the company Roblox group. roblox_upload_licence_ok is true only for original assets.
_field_guide.policy: Code-generated audio is pre-approved (still measure and fill this receipt). fal and Suno clips, and every generated mesh, image and video, need an owner review per asset. No upload until the company Roblox group exists and the owner says yes to this exact asset. No generation without a recorded spend approval.
_field_guide.measured.post_transcode_true_peak_dbtp: Owner-machine step: after the first upload, re-download or capture the transcoded asset on the owner's own computer and measure true peak once. post_transcode_verified becomes true only when it is at or below -1 dBTP.
_field_guide.roblox.quota_counted_against: Which account the upload counted against (the uploading member or the group), as shown after upload. Open item until the first upload.
